name: KEST
fix_description: In _transfer, when neither from nor to is a market address (non-market transfer), the balances are never updated despite emitting a Transfer event. Add an else branch to handle regular transfers: _balances[from] = fromBalance - amount; _balances[to] += amount. Also change the second if(isMarket(to)) to else if to prevent double execution when both from and to are market addresses.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC requires understanding Uniswap V2 pair mechanics, fee-on-transfer token behavior, mint/skim/swap interactions, and a repeated liquidity-manipulation loop rather than a simple one-call bug. While it is contained to a single protocol pair and one flash loan, the exploit path is multi-step and protocol-specific enough that an experienced auditor would likely need 30 minutes to 2 hours to reconstruct confidently.
